svg.title: Eight two-week experiments across delivery, security, scalability and governance
svg.desc: A grid of eight experiments, two per topic, each ending in one metric. Delivery: replay closed issues with HydraFusion against one frontier model, measuring pass rate, time and cost; route new issues to CODEOWNERS teams, measuring accuracy at a confidence threshold. Security: gate agent tool calls with allow, block or escalate, measuring catch rate against false blocks; rank existing alerts by exploitability, measuring agreement with human triage. Scalability: label 100,000 records with a decision model and an LLM, measuring p95 latency and cost per thousand; swap only an agent loop’s continue and stop calls, measuring task time and success. Governance: check calibration on 1,000 examples with a reliability diagram; paraphrase and shuffle the same inputs, measuring the decision flip rate.
